name: talea/talea
description: Self-hosted website builder (a fork of Talea).

scripts-descriptions.test: All suites, six processes in parallel (needs the db-test service)
scripts-descriptions.test:pg: The integration suite against PostgreSQL 18 (db-test-pg service; TALEA_TEST_PG_* for another server)
scripts-descriptions.test:site: Whole installed sites over HTTP, one class per site, in parallel
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e: Update from image N to N+1 in a docker compose project (needs Docker; builds the image, minutes)
scripts-descriptions.test:browser: Chrome walk of a clean install (needs Node, Chrome, network)
